prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Bring your virtual pet to life directly on your desktop screen.", "Preview Pet"]
1: ["Ready to Interact With Your Pet!"]
2: ["Choose Your Companion Archetype"]
3: ["Protect Your Pet with Cloud Sync", "Sign in to save your pet's memory, items, and settings safely to your account.", "Sign In to Save Progress"]
4: ["Setting up your desktop companion. This usually takes around 1 to 2 minutes."]
5: ["Choose How to Begin", "Select a ready-made digital companion or generate a unique pet from your photos.", "Continue with Path"]
6: ["Upload well-lit, forward-facing photos for the crispest 3D pet generation."]
7: ["Onboarding Complete! Here is Your Free Pet Accessory", "Your pet is now active on your desktop. Enjoy your exclusive starter hat accessory!", "Starter Pack Unlocked"]
8: ["Sign In First to Protect Your Creation"]
9: ["Preparing Desktop Pet", "You can use other apps while we prepare. We will notify you as soon as your pet arrives."]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal photos of the user
Asks to upload personal photos of the user
Mentions free extras, exclusive accessories, and starter gifts
